rules.rule: Indicators, breakout channels, and signals must be computed from completed prior bars only. Flag any read of a channel or indicator that includes the bar being decided on.
Position, stop, and pyramid state may change only in response to a recorded fill or brokerage event — never at order-submission time and never from a quoted price.

Every position addition must compute aggregate open risk after the proposed action and reject it if a per-stock, sector, or portfolio limit would be exceeded. Each Unit must not receive a fresh full risk budget.

Domain code must be deterministic: no time.Now() or wall-clock reads, no unseeded randomness, no output-affecting map iteration order, no network/filesystem/database access inside a strategy calculation. Time and all inputs arrive via events.
N must be the 20-day Wilder average of True Range, N = (19*PDN + TR)/20 seeded with a 20-day SMA of TR. Flag a simple moving average of True Range, or any average of price, used as N.
The LEAN adapter must contain no methodology: no position sizing, pyramid state, drawdown logic, or portfolio-risk decisions. It translates events and submits already-validated orders.
internal/ domain packages must not import LEAN, database, transport, or HTTP packages. cmd/ is composition only.

Turtle baseline (1/2N adds, 2N stop) and Sublime/hybrid variants (1 ATR adds, ~3xATR stop, risk-free-before-add) are distinct named configurations. Flag code that blends them or hard-codes one where a versioned configuration parameter belongs.
A zero, negative, or insufficiently warmed-up volatility value must fail closed and prevent a trade proposal, never silently produce a position size.
Constants encoding a strategy rule (55, 20, 2N, 1/2N, 4 Units, 10%/20% drawdown) must carry a comment citing their source document and page or timestamp.
New or changed strategy behaviour must come with a test that would have failed before the change. Golden scenarios must be transcribed from primary sources with a citation, not invented.
Do not compare prices with ==. Be explicit about decimal versus float and about rounding direction for share quantities (the Turtle rule truncates).
